cards.title: Not sure where to start?
cards.body: Answer eight questions about your space and program. You get a free readiness report you can share with your team.

faqs.q: What does a turnkey esports lab include?
faqs.a: Whatever you need. We can handle the whole thing: room design, electrical, network and cabling, hardware, AV, cybersecurity, curriculum, league play, and support after launch. Or we can take on one piece and work with what you already have.

faqs.q: How much does an esports lab cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the room, the number of stations, and what you already have. Discovery and planning are free. You see the final scope and price before anything is built, and you can buy through DIR, OMNIA, NCPA, or GSA. We also help you look for grants.

faqs.q: We have never done this before. Can you still help?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of our clients were starting from an empty room. One team walks you through planning, design, approval, the build, and the first season. If you are not sure where to start, the free assessment is a good first step.

faqs.q: Will this make more work for our IT team?
faqs.a: It should make less. We have done enterprise IT for 28 years, so the network, security, and support are set up to your IT department’s standards, and we manage them after launch.

faqs.q: Do you support the lab after it opens?
faqs.a: Yes. We monitor, patch, and manage the systems remotely, and you can call a real person when something comes up. Curriculum and league play are there if you want them.

statsV1.label: Years of IT expertise behind every build

faqsV1.q: What does a turnkey esports lab actually include?
faqsV1.a: It depends on what you need. That’s the point. We can handle everything: facility design, electrical, network and cabling, hardware, AV, cybersecurity, curriculum, league play, and ongoing managed support. Or we can step in for just one piece. We work with what you have and build from there.

faqsV1.q: How much does an esports facility cost?
faqsV1.a: Every build is scoped to your space, goals, and budget, so there’s no one-size price. Discovery and planning cost nothing: you get a final scope and pricing to sign off on before anything is built, mapped to purchasing contracts like DIR, OMNIA, NCPA, and GSA, with grant funding where available.

faqsV1.q: Do you work with schools, institutions, and businesses that have never done this before?
faqsV1.a: Yes. One team takes you from an empty room to your first season and beyond: discover, plan, design, approve, build and launch, then scale with support, curriculum, and league play. Not sure where to start? Begin with the free assessment.

faqsV1.q: Will this create challenges for our IT team?
faqsV1.a: It’s designed to do the opposite. With 28 years of enterprise IT behind every build, networking, cybersecurity, and managed support are specced to your IT department’s standards.

faqsV1.q: Do you offer managed IT and ongoing support after installation?
faqsV1.a: Yes. After launch we monitor, patch, and manage everything remotely, with real people to call. Curriculum and league play keep the program growing, as much or as little as you need.
